digest.component_or_area: transition / claim command library surface + cli + internal naming
propositions: The transition library function signature diverges from claim: transition splits force-bypass into force (bool), reason (str), and force_close (str) while claim uses a single force (str|None) parameter carrying the audit reason

The transition CLI allows --reason to serve double-duty as both close_reason and force-bypass audit note, while claim couples the force reason tightly to --force[=<reason>], creating inconsistent external surfaces
Internal naming spells the single concept of force-bypass reason four different ways (force_reason, force_close, force_close_reason, force_plan_review) across transition and claim subsystems
Legacy callers using transition(force_close="x") or transition(force=True) must be mapped to the new unified force="x" shape with deprecation warnings via _deprecations
The persisted status_data["force_close_reason"] schema key must remain unchanged for backward compatibility while in-memory plumbing unifies to force_reason spelling
